---
title: "Supply"
subtitle: "Doctoral degrees in Mathematics and statistics"
execute:
  echo: false
---

These charts are counts of **degrees awarded** (Eurostat `educ_uoe_grad02`, ISCED `ED8`, field `F054`). They are not employment rates.

Missing country-years are missing. A zero is a zero, including Denmark’s run of zeros after 2014, which looks like a reporting break and is not corrected.

```{python}
from pathlib import Path

import pandas as pd
import plotly.express as px
import plotly.graph_objects as go
from IPython.display import Markdown, display

DATA = Path("data/supply/eurostat-f054/graduates_long.csv")

df = pd.read_csv(DATA)
df["year"] = df["year"].astype(int)

totals = df[(df["sex"] == "T") & (~df["is_aggregate"])].copy()
eu27 = df[(df["geo"] == "EU27_2020") & (df["sex"] == "T")].copy()

latest = int(df["year"].max())
latest_countries = totals[totals["year"] == latest].dropna(subset=["graduates"]).sort_values("graduates", ascending=False)
italy_latest = totals[(totals["country"] == "Italy") & (totals["year"] == latest)].dropna(subset=["graduates"])

italy_bit = (
    f"Italy’s published count in {latest} is **{int(italy_latest['graduates'].iloc[0]):,}** degrees."
    if len(italy_latest)
    else f"Italy has no published total for {latest}."
)

display(Markdown(
    f"Snapshot years **{int(df['year'].min())}–{latest}**. "
    f"In {latest}, **{len(latest_countries)}** countries have a non-missing total. "
    f"{italy_bit}"
))
```

## Official EU-27 total

This line is Eurostat’s `EU27_2020` series, not a sum of the country rows below. Years with no official aggregate are omitted.

```{python}
fig = px.line(
    eu27.dropna(subset=["graduates"]),
    x="year",
    y="graduates",
    markers=True,
    labels={"year": "Year", "graduates": "Doctoral degrees (F054)"},
)
fig.update_layout(
    title="EU-27 (Eurostat aggregate): mathematics and statistics doctorates",
    yaxis_title="Degrees awarded",
    xaxis=dict(dtick=1),
    margin=dict(t=50, l=40, r=20, b=40),
    height=380,
)
fig.show()
```

## Countries in the latest year

```{python}
fig = px.bar(
    latest_countries,
    x="graduates",
    y="country",
    orientation="h",
    labels={"graduates": "Doctoral degrees (F054)", "country": ""},
)
fig.update_layout(
    title=f"F054 doctoral degrees in {latest} (countries with a published total)",
    height=max(420, 22 * len(latest_countries)),
    margin=dict(t=50, l=10, r=20, b=40),
    yaxis=dict(autorange="reversed"),
)
fig.show()
```

## One country over time

Pick a country. Empty years are unpublished, not zero.

```{python}
country_order = sorted(totals["country"].unique())
default = "Italy" if "Italy" in country_order else country_order[0]
series = totals.sort_values(["country", "year"])

fig = go.Figure()
for country, part in series.groupby("country", sort=False):
    fig.add_trace(
        go.Scatter(
            x=part["year"],
            y=part["graduates"],
            mode="lines+markers",
            name=country,
            visible=(country == default),
            connectgaps=False,
        )
    )

buttons = []
for i, country in enumerate(country_order):
    visible = [c == country for c in country_order]
    buttons.append(dict(label=country, method="update", args=[{"visible": visible}, {"title": f"{country}: F054 doctoral degrees"}]))

fig.update_layout(
    title=f"{default}: F054 doctoral degrees",
    updatemenus=[dict(buttons=buttons, x=0, xanchor="left", y=1.18, yanchor="top")],
    xaxis=dict(title="Year", dtick=1),
    yaxis=dict(title="Degrees awarded"),
    height=420,
    margin=dict(t=80, l=40, r=20, b=40),
    showlegend=False,
)
fig.show()
```

## Sex

Eurostat publishes women, men, and a total. The total is Eurostat’s total, not always the sum of the two sexes (rounding and missing sex breakdowns happen).

```{python}
sex = df[(~df["is_aggregate"]) & (df["sex"].isin(["F", "M"]))].copy()
latest_sex = sex[sex["year"] == latest].dropna(subset=["graduates"])

fig = px.bar(
    latest_sex.sort_values("country"),
    x="country",
    y="graduates",
    color="sex_label",
    barmode="group",
    labels={"graduates": "Doctoral degrees (F054)", "country": "", "sex_label": ""},
)
fig.update_layout(
    title=f"Women and men, {latest} (published cells only)",
    height=420,
    margin=dict(t=50, l=40, r=20, b=80),
    xaxis_tickangle=-45,
)
fig.show()
```

Italy is missing 2015–2018 in this table. Those years are not estimated on this page. See [Methods](methods.qmd) for the Denmark zeros and the other exclusions.

## Students in the programme

Eurostat `educ_uoe_enrt03`: people **enrolled** in an F054 doctorate that year, not degrees awarded.

```{python}
enr = pd.read_csv("data/supply/eurostat-enrt03-f054/enrolments_long.csv")
enr["year"] = enr["year"].astype(int)
enr_eu = enr[(enr["geo"] == "EU27_2020") & (enr["sex"] == "T")].dropna(subset=["enrolments"])
enr_latest_year = int(enr["year"].max())
enr_countries = (
    enr[(enr["year"] == enr_latest_year) & (enr["sex"] == "T") & (~enr["is_aggregate"])]
    .dropna(subset=["enrolments"])
    .sort_values("enrolments", ascending=False)
)
it_enr = enr[(enr["country"] == "Italy") & (enr["sex"] == "T") & (enr["year"] == enr_latest_year)].dropna(subset=["enrolments"])
it_enr_bit = (
    f"Italy: **{int(it_enr['enrolments'].iloc[0]):,}** students in {enr_latest_year}."
    if len(it_enr)
    else f"Italy has no published enrolment for {enr_latest_year}."
)
display(Markdown(
    f"EU-27 official aggregate in years that exist. {it_enr_bit}"
))

fig = px.line(
    enr_eu,
    x="year",
    y="enrolments",
    markers=True,
    labels={"year": "Year", "enrolments": "Students enrolled (F054, ED8)"},
)
fig.update_layout(
    title="EU-27 (Eurostat aggregate): students in mathematics and statistics doctorates",
    xaxis=dict(dtick=1),
    height=380,
    margin=dict(t=50, l=40, r=20, b=40),
)
fig.show()

fig = px.bar(
    enr_countries,
    x="enrolments",
    y="country",
    orientation="h",
    labels={"enrolments": "Students enrolled (F054, ED8)", "country": ""},
)
fig.update_layout(
    title=f"F054 doctoral enrolments in {enr_latest_year} (published totals)",
    height=max(420, 22 * len(enr_countries)),
    margin=dict(t=50, l=10, r=20, b=40),
    yaxis=dict(autorange="reversed"),
)
fig.show()
```

## Degree-mobile graduates

Eurostat `educ_uoe_mobg01`: F054 doctorates awarded to people whose **prior education was in another country**. Not all foreign citizens, and not employment.

```{python}
mob = pd.read_csv("data/supply/eurostat-mobg01-f054/mobile_graduates_long.csv")
mob["year"] = mob["year"].astype(int)
mob_eu = mob[(mob["geo"] == "EU27_2020") & (mob["sex"] == "T")].dropna(subset=["mobile_graduates"])
mob_latest = int(mob["year"].max())
mob_countries = (
    mob[(mob["year"] == mob_latest) & (mob["sex"] == "T") & (~mob["is_aggregate"])]
    .dropna(subset=["mobile_graduates"])
    .sort_values("mobile_graduates", ascending=False)
)
grad_eu_latest = eu27[(eu27["year"] == mob_latest)].dropna(subset=["graduates"])
ratio_bit = ""
if len(mob_eu[mob_eu["year"] == mob_latest]) and len(grad_eu_latest):
    m = float(mob_eu.loc[mob_eu["year"] == mob_latest, "mobile_graduates"].iloc[0])
    g = float(grad_eu_latest["graduates"].iloc[0])
    ratio_bit = (
        f" In {mob_latest} Eurostat’s EU-27 mobile count is **{m:,.0f}** and its EU-27 graduate count is **{g:,.0f}** "
        f"({100 * m / g:.0f}% of that official graduate aggregate)."
    )
display(Markdown(
    "The EU-27 mobile series is sparse; only published years are shown." + ratio_bit
))

if len(mob_eu):
    fig = px.line(
        mob_eu,
        x="year",
        y="mobile_graduates",
        markers=True,
        labels={"year": "Year", "mobile_graduates": "Degree-mobile F054 doctorates"},
    )
    fig.update_layout(
        title="EU-27 (Eurostat aggregate): degree-mobile F054 doctorates",
        xaxis=dict(dtick=1),
        height=340,
        margin=dict(t=50, l=40, r=20, b=40),
    )
    fig.show()

fig = px.bar(
    mob_countries,
    x="mobile_graduates",
    y="country",
    orientation="h",
    labels={"mobile_graduates": "Degree-mobile F054 doctorates", "country": ""},
)
fig.update_layout(
    title=f"Degree-mobile F054 doctorates in {mob_latest} (published totals)",
    height=max(420, 22 * len(mob_countries)),
    margin=dict(t=50, l=10, r=20, b=40),
    yaxis=dict(autorange="reversed"),
)
fig.show()
```
